battleTactics.name: Take What's Theirs
battleTactics.description: They don't own it; they're merely holding onto it until you run them through.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of the turn if you control a relic that is within enemy territory.

command.name: Prepared Riposte
command.declare: Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
command.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target has STRIKE-FIRST while it is in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn.

battleTactics.name: Pitiless Murder
battleTactics.description: There is no honour in Embergard, and many meet their end surrounded and set upon in some dismal alley.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if an enemy unit was picked to be the target of all the combat attacks made by 2 or more different friendly units this turn.

command.name: Motivated by Greed
command.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 6" of a relic to be the target.
command.effect: Add D6 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

battleTactics.name: Take the Flanks
battleTactics.description: Surround the enemy before you close in for the kill.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are any friendly units within 3" of each short battlefield edge.

command.name: Rigged Explosions
command.declare: Pick a relic. Then, pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that relic to be the targets.
command.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

battleTactics.name: Cut Off the Head
battleTactics.description: Claim the head of the enemy's general to shatter their morale.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if the enemy general was slain this turn OR the enemy general was slain in an earlier turn and any enemy units were destroyed this turn.

command.name: Counter-Charge
command.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
command.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

battleTactics.name: Raid
battleTactics.description: Drive deep into enemy territory and wreak havoc!
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if any friendly units are wholly within enemy territory and not in combat.

command.name: Race for the Loot
command.declare: Pick a relic on the battlefield to be the target.
command.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units can finish charge moves within ½" of the target as if it were an enemy unit.

battleTactics.name: Protect the Loot
battleTactics.description: What good is treasure if you can't hang onto it?
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if an enemy unit was destroyed by a friendly unit while that friendly unit was within 3" of a relic.

command.name: Last-Ditch Effort
command.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has been destroyed and has not already been replaced.
command.effect: Set up either a replacement unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 4 or a single-model replacement unit with X damage points already allocated to it, where X is its Health characteristic minus 4. The unit must be set up more than 6" from all enemy units.

battleTactics.name: Hold the Centre
battleTactics.description: Take the middle ground, and be the rock upon which the enemy shatters.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 2 or more friendly units within 3" of the centre of the battlefield.

command.name: Slip Away
command.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to be the target.
command.effect: The target can move 5". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but it cannot end that move in combat.

battleTactics.name: Raze
battleTactics.description: Break through enemy lines so you can plunge into the city beyond.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are any friendly units within 3" of the long battlefield edge in enemy territory.

command.name: Covetous Frenzy
command.declare: Pick a relic to be the target.
command.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly units while they are within 3" of the target.

battleTactics.name: Dais of the Comet
battleTactics.description: The Twin-Tailed Comet is an omen of great significance.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control the Twin-Tailed Comet objective.

command.name: Go Down Fighting
command.declare: Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
command.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 5+ for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

battleTactics.name: Dais of the Hammer
battleTactics.description: Sigmar's sacred hammer is a potent symbol of might.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control the Ghal Maraz objective.

command.name: Fool's Gold
command.declare: Pick a relic on the battlefield to be the target.
command.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again more than 3" from all enemy units and more than 6" away from all other relics.

battleTactics.name: Comb the Area
battleTactics.description: It has been impressed on all of your warriors that returning empty-handed is not an option.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if all friendly units are within 3" of a relic (it does not need to be the same relic).

command.name: Redeploy
command.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
command.effect: That unit can move D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

battleTactics.name: Material Gains
battleTactics.description: Valuable resources lie scattered about this quarter of Embergard. Secure them before the enemy can do the same.
battleTactics.requirement: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control more relics than your opponent.

command.name: Grind Them to Dust
command.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
command.effect: That unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit and it has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
